generated.description: A large, mostly solid house built from stone and black terracotta, with gray terracotta, snow blocks, and dark oak accents. It is about 68 by 68 blocks across and 31 high, with a stepped, fortress-like massing, a dirt and podzol garden, and a few black stained glass windows. Inside it has furnaces, hoppers, a beacon, flower pots, and signs, and the front shows a tall roofed tower on one side.
